gpu_identity_policy: LOGICAL slots only; the operator binds each slot to a physical device at dispatch time. No host names, no device UUIDs, no operator identifiers appear in this plan or in any launch manifest.
counterbalancing: one seed per slot; within-slot arm order is the design's counterbalanced order (C-T / T-C / T-C / C-T), so arm and execution position are orthogonal across the fleet and any slot-level drift (thermal, clock, driver state) hits both arms symmetrically
worktree_policy: each slot executes from its own read-only git worktree pinned to the correction commit; no fetch, no checkout, no edit during the campaign; the driver re-verifies design/seal/architecture digests per cell before construction
launch_manifests: docs/audits/evidence/paired_sac_launch_manifests_20260828/ (eight v2 files, authored and committed BEFORE any execution; each binds slot, within-slot position, the exact command WITH --logical-slot, the full verified cell genesis, and the canonical executable allowlist — 18 file digests, allowlist digest f3cce8af63fe6ea2...)
thermal_telemetry: tools/gpu_temperature_watchdog.py runs on every executing host for the entire campaign; its log is part of each slot's terminal evidence
terminal_report_validation: per cell: custody verified_render(key) must succeed (intent+ACK+completed+digest agreement), the cell record must satisfy schema agent_multi.paired_sac_cell_record.v1, and predeclared refusals (activity, constant-policy, dead-actor) are typed outcomes — a cell that ends any other way is INVALID and reported, never retried under the same identity
interruption_policy: non-resumable (order C3): any interruption yields a fresh attempt identity; the interrupted custody record stays terminal forever
no_venue_socket: the driver refuses any venue-credential key; training and evaluation touch only the pinned local CSV roles

eta.measured_cpu_dry_run: 19.7 min per arm for the bounded 2,600-step cell on 4 CPU threads (2,472 gradient updates + 5 full-role evaluation rollouts); both arms identical wall within measurement resolution — the transfer adds no measurable runtime
eta.prior_gpu_throughput_basis: P1 lineage measured ~7-9 h per training phase on one RTX-class GPU at comparable model width; design estimate 6-10 h per 260k-step cell including the 100 assessment rollouts
eta.fleet_wall_estimate: 12-20 h with all four logical slots executing in parallel; 48-80 GPU-hours total across the eight cells — consistent with the design's predeclared envelope

authorization: GPU execution requires the typed artifact agent_multi.paired_sac_dispatch_authorization.v1 (template committed at docs/audits/evidence/PAIRED_SAC_DISPATCH_AUTHORIZATION_TEMPLATE_2026_08_28.json); the driver verifies every field, the executable allowlist, exact HEAD equality and worktree cleanliness before any CUDA probe or model construction; exactly ONE CUDA device must be visible per cell process (DATA-SOTA-377/379/380)
